fields.title: Bahamas RGD search-result record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (and _error/_errorDetail on failures). Each successful record is one matched entity from RGD's free public name-search (top 3 matches only -- see README/CRAWLING_METHOD.md), with upstream's own field names passed through verbatim. Most upstream fields are null on the free tier -- only entityId/entityName/legacyMigrationStatus are reliably populated.

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact query (company/business name) that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: S1-public-entities (current-name search), S2-public-entities-history (former-name search), or none (error record).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

_error.title: Error
_error.description: Present only on failed searches -- not_found (search matched nothing), result_set_too_broad (query too short/common, upstream returned an empty response -- retry with a more specific name), or blocked_or_transient (network issue).

_errorDetail.title: Error detail
_errorDetail.description: Free-form diagnostic detail, present only alongside _error.

entityId.title: Entity ID
entityId.description: RGD's internal numeric ID for this entity (used to reference it if paying for the full Company Search Report on rgd.gov.bs).

entityName.title: Entity name
entityName.description: Registered company/business name exactly as on file.

entityType.title: Entity type
entityType.description: Upstream field -- null on every free-tier result seen during recon (part of the paid report).

entityNumber.title: Entity/registration number
entityNumber.description: Upstream field -- null on every free-tier result seen during recon (part of the paid report).

entityStatus.title: Entity status
entityStatus.description: Upstream field -- null on every free-tier result seen during recon (part of the paid report).

registrationDate.title: Registration date
registrationDate.description: Upstream field -- null on every free-tier result seen during recon (part of the paid report).

legacyMigrationStatus.title: Legacy migration status
legacyMigrationStatus.description: Upstream internal tag, e.g. "NONE" -- populated on every sample seen.

nameHistoryId.title: Name history ID
nameHistoryId.description: Present only when includeHistory=true: RGD's internal ID for this former-name record.

name.title: Former name
name.description: Present only when includeHistory=true: the former/historical name that matched the query.

entity.title: Entity (nested)
entity.description: Present only when includeHistory=true: the current entity record this former name belongs to, same shape as the plain search result.

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns for matched entities and error rows.
